item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server in India South Central
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server is now generally available in the India South Central Azure region. Users can deploy new flexible server instances in that region.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Microsoft Azure now available from new cloud region in India (India South Central)
item.description:
Microsoft has launched a new Azure datacenter region in India, India South Central, with campuses in Hyderabad, Telangana. The region is intended to provide local cloud infrastructure for customers in India.

  • Source: Azure Updates
